newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-LOJAS RENNER BEGUN AS MKT PERFORMER.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-LOJAS RENNER BEGUN AS MKT PERFORMER.

text.p: Caspian Securities said Wednesday it has begun coverage of Brazilian retailer Lojas Renner with a market performer rating and a 1998 price target of 66 reais per 1,000 shares, representing a 29-percent return.

-- Caspian analyst Esther Hiranobe said in a report that the year-end price target was based on a price-earnings ratio of 11.4x, which represents a 10 percent premium to the oil sector's average. "We believe this premium is justified as the company has a superior management team and strong operating performance," she wrote.
-- Caspian believes the stock is fairly valued and that a re-rating should take place if there is unexpectedly strong demand in the apparel retail sector, she said.

-- Lojas Renner operates mostly in southern Brazil but has recently begun its expansion into Sao Paulo state and is expected to consolidate its brand name in the region in the next few years, she added.
-- "We expect an increase in sales expenses as introducing the Lojas Renner brand name in the Sao Paulo, where it is yet unknown, will require an intensive marketing effort," Hiranobe said.
-- Lojas Renner preferred shares were untraded after closing August 8 at 51 reais while its common was untraded since August 1, when it closed at 52 reais in Sao Paulo.
-- "(It) should consolidate its brand name in the region over the next few years," Hiranobe wrote.
